title: PPI v1 citation
description: Evidence for a claim, a search hit or a recommendation. All five fields are always present: `attachment_ref` is null when the cited text is the rendered record itself, and `page` is null when the cited unit has no pages. A claim that cannot carry at least one citation is not made; the answer is `insufficient_evidence` instead.

quote.description: The exact text at `span`. Hosts show it next to a link to the cited record, attachment and page, after re-checking that the viewer may see them.

source_version.description: The version of the cited record or attachment the span refers to.
